asset.mark_source: CoinGecko live global volume-weighted UNI/USD observed during run

signal_change.interpretation: UNI moved from below the default 7.5% non-core cap to 8.06% solely through appreciation. This is a material concentration/crowding change, but not itself a thesis failure.

protocol_fundamentals.interpretation: Protocol economics accelerated alongside the token move, so the breakout is not price-only. Existing fee-to-UNI-burn value-capture thesis remains active from prior observations.

notes: Three newly created wallets previously received/withdrew 782,130 UNI through Galaxy Digital, Bybit/OKX and Binance/Gate.
Historical selectivity, beneficial-owner independence and repeat buying remain unresolved.
No fresh broad distribution cohort was verified in this run; the known Sep 19 600k UNI sale remains an older counterflow rather than a new trigger.
The new event is UNI token price/turnover persistence and protocol fee/revenue acceleration, not a newly identified stablecoin/bridge migration into one chain.
Marketwide short-covering remains a contamination variable, but UNI's seven-day gain materially exceeds the broader crypto market.
CME futures are an already-recorded catalyst and are not counted again as a fresh independent confirmation.
No new sellability, honeypot, liquidity-removal, privileged mint/freeze, deployer-dump or executable-liquidity failure surfaced.
Existing governance/upgradeability and supply caveats remain.

liquidity_executability.notes: CoinGecko reports about $2.11B of 24h UNI turnover across 146 exchanges / 344 markets; top CEX books show tight spreads and ample depth for the paper position.

leadership_assessment: UNI has moved from confirmation to clear token-level leadership: price, turnover and protocol economics all accelerated. The move is extended, however, and the paper position is now above the default non-core sizing cap through appreciation.
portfolio_rationale: The 7.5% figure is a default sizing cap, not an automatic price-appreciation rebalance rule. The position crossed it without a structural or thesis failure, while fees/revenue accelerated. A mechanical trim solely because price rose would truncate the prospective leadership test. No add is permitted. A trim becomes justified if >8% concentration persists while distribution, derivatives crowding, liquidity deterioration or value-capture weakening appears.

major_uncertainties: No fresh wallet-lineage evidence resolves whether the Sep 22 accumulation wallets are independent beneficial owners or historically selective.
The rapid UNI repricing may contain marketwide short-covering and event-driven CME anticipation.
Position concentration is above the default non-core cap, increasing drawdown sensitivity even though it was created by appreciation rather than a new add.
forward_tests: No further UNI add while weight exceeds 7.5%.
Recheck whether UNI remains above 8% of NAV after the next full mark rather than reacting to a single fast repricing.

Trim prospectively if concentration persists together with fresh whale distribution, derivatives-led rather than spot-led price discovery, weakening fee/burn economics or any structural-gate deterioration.
If leadership persists with organic protocol economics and no distribution, allow appreciation drift rather than mechanically rebalancing the winner.
